scope: Internal registered cached metadata/readiness/report prototype; no qualified molecular replay or autonomous reasoning claim

cases.name: Search and inspect a registered source with exact metadata and portable attribution
Unknown/protected aliases reject before opening a payload; caller cannot supply source paths or roles
Readiness plans retain declared units, unresolved fields, source gaps and decision scope
Cited report and local preview/export are reproducible and idempotent; no external destination writes
Malformed tool arguments, invalid readout selection and unsupported tool names fail safely
MCP lifecycle and actual newline JSON-RPC transport support initialize, initialized, tools/list, tools/call and ping
MCP parser/error boundaries contain no private payload text; oversized input and preinitialize calls fail
Interrupted persistence, stale revisions, changed sources/reports and duplicate exports preserve integrity
Portable visual demonstration uses only approved projected metadata and links to matching report identities
Fresh-process reproduction matches content hashes; inputs/code/outputs return before exact scoped cleanup
